text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The one who showed a magnificent run in 
the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What was that race just now? What on earth 
was that feeling――
(A shiver—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Her voice, her momentum. The sensation of 
being completely overwhelmed still lingers 
in my body...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah! Geez!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely, DEFINITELY 
win...! Don't you think I'm staying like 
this forever...!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Can she still grow even further? 
Beyond what she is now...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then next time, without fail, I will—

Ever since returning to the waiting room, 
Biwa Hayahide's expression has remained 
clouded.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. No need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Surely this is the result of my own 
hubris... No, perhaps there was simply a 
flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then we just need to find the cause of the 
suboptimal solution. Surely, it does not 
mean no solution exists.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This is a miscalculation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words, once the formula is 
corrected, there is nothing to fear. Even 
the vision of my defeat has vanished...!

Even as she speaks, Biwa Hayahide's voice 
gradually grows faint.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next... is the Derby already!! I'm 
gonna... win it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Definitely, definitely, absolutely!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become... a Derby Umamusume!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...What loud voices. To think I can hear 
them all the way from this room...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She is... incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
F-Forgive me! Let us begin re-analyzing 
immediately. There is so little time left 
until the Derby, after all...

Just as she said, our next goal is the 
second leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
the Japanese Derby (Tokyo Yushun).

Yet as her words urged me along, I 
couldn't shake the feeling that the gears 
were slowly grinding out of alignment.
